Read the physics first

Why does my power station shut off when the pump or fridge starts? Locked-rotor current lasts a fraction of a second and is judged against the surge ceiling, not the continuous rating. With three published examples. Read the answer → What should you actually keep running during a power outage? Rank loads by watt-hours per day, not by how important they feel. Router, fridge and CPAP fit a mid-size battery. One space heater does not. Read the answer → How much power does a balcony solar setup actually produce? A panel’s rated watts are a lab figure at one irradiance and temperature. A balcony array steps that down by orientation, tilt, shading and heat. Read the answer →

Where every number comes from

official Manufacturer specification, transcribed from the published sheet with the URL and the date it was read. Every figure on the site today is this tier.
measured A measurement of our own. The library holds none yet, so the site claims none. When the first one lands it appears here, labelled and dated, and it will say what it disagreed with.
user A reader's log. Submissions are not open yet. When they are, a figure is held in review until three independent logs of the same pairing agree, and it stays marked as a user log afterwards.

We publish no figure without a tier and a verification date — including the ones that say we do not know.
